species: Proteins were extracted from an adult female of O. lupi using the TriPure (Roche Molecular Biochemicals, Basel, Switzerland) protocol as described below and quantified (0.55 μg/μl) using the QUBIT Protein Assay kit (Foster City, California, USA) according to the manufacturer instructions and subjected to SDS-PAGE and Western Blotting as previously described.
